# @uptimizr/r3f

> The react-three-fiber connector for Uptimizr. A thin React layer over `@uptimizr/three`: it
> reads the live scene/camera/gl from the R3F store via `useThree()` and hands them to the three
> connector, stopping capture on unmount. `react`, `@react-three/fiber` and `three` are peer
> dependencies. Sessions are attributed to the `r3f` connector.

## Docs

- [Package reference](./README.md): component + hook usage, options, replay, package boundary.
- [Agent guide](./AGENTS.md): rules and canonical usage for AI agents.
- [Connector guide](https://uptimizr.com/docs/connectors/r3f/): the docs-site walkthrough.
- [three connector](../sdk-three/README.md): the capture engine and the full option surface.
- [Integration & API reference](https://github.com/RaananW/Uptimizr/blob/main/docs/integration.md): track and query the data.
- [Architecture Decision Records](https://github.com/RaananW/Uptimizr/tree/main/docs/adr): privacy model (0003), input-source-agnostic events (0011), sampling & fidelity (0012), coordinate frame & connector provenance (0018).

## Key exports

- `useUptimizr(options)` — the headless hook; returns an `UptimizrClientRef`.
- `<Uptimizr {...options} />` — the declarative component (render it inside `<Canvas>`).
- `UptimizrOptions` — an alias of `@uptimizr/three`'s `TrackSceneOptions`.
- `createSceneRaycaster`, `createGazeRaycaster`, `createXrRaycaster` — re-exported hit-resolution probes.
- Re-exported option types: `TrackSceneOptions`, `ThreeCaptureOptions`, `MeshVisibilityOptions`, `HoverDwellOptions`, `ResourceSampleOptions`.
